title: Data and analysis code: Genotype-specific antioxidant, reactive-carbonyl and polyamine responses underlying heat tolerance in six winter wheat cultivars
description: Raw data and R scripts that reproduce every statistical analysis and figure of the article "Genotype-specific antioxidant, reactive-carbonyl and polyamine responses underlying heat tolerance in six winter wheat cultivars" (Rahman, Habib et al., 2026, Frontiers in Plant Science 17:1973386, https://doi.org/10.3389/fpls.2026.1973386). Six Martonvasar winter wheat cultivars were grown at 20, 35 and 40 degrees C and profiled for shoot biomass, leaf gas exchange, photosynthetic pigments, ascorbate-glutathione enzymes, reactive-carbonyl detoxification enzymes, phenylalanine ammonia-lyase and free polyamines. Numbered scripts fit two-way linear models with Type II ANOVA and Tukey-adjusted comparisons within temperature, run the principal component analysis, the stress-tolerance-index heatmap and the Spearman correlation matrices, and assemble the supplementary tables. Code is released under the MIT licence and the data files under CC BY 4.0.
